scope: E0 semantic data/artifact/occupancy audit; no method development
freeze_status: AUDIT_AND_METRIC_FREEZE; not a training execution seal

phase_contract.overlap: exclude shared event time support from phase-specific attribution and report exclusions; do not drop events
phase_contract.point_RCI: require actual observed timestamp and causally available score; no widening root label
phase_contract.downsampling: retain native timestamp masks; mixed-phase bins not eligible for primary RCI/EEI attribution; no max-type union substitute

score_contract.primary: finite raw higher-is-anomalous scores available no later than assigned target timestamp; no future enclosing-window averaging, backfill, warmup zero, EWMA or label-informed padding
score_contract.missing_score: missingness and support counted; never zero/model failure
score_contract.coverage: expected native1s grid, including absent timestamps; shared-event instants excluded and counted

F1.root_cause_capture: any score>normal-only threshold at eligible RCI timestamp; report event-length false-alarm reference and raw separation alongside; no observed alarm with incomplete RCI support -> N/A, not false
F1.effect_only_detection: complete eligible native RCI evidence, none alarm, EEI has eligible alarm(s); incomplete RCI or missing EEI -> N/A
F1.delay_seconds: first causal event alarm minus rootstart only with complete event support/no ambiguous overlap; otherwise N/A, first observed alarm delay kept separately as partial evidence
F1.separation: phase median versus pre-RCI median and heldout normal quantiles; no score-positive-only ratio

F2.fragment: consecutive eligible timestamps at native1s cadence; missing timestamp/score breaks runs
F2.dropout: fraction eligible phase scores <=threshold; report missing coverage separately
F2.raw_continuity: median adjacent absolute score change / normal calibration IQR; same valid cadence only
F2.comparison: joint point AP/rangeAD2/earlyAD3/exactly_onceAD4 only if same native phase/split contract; no optimized same-AP subset selection

F3.calibration: heldout normal validation scores only; anomalous labels prohibited
F3.per_app: same normal-only quantile only with deployment-available app ID and adequate calibration support
F3.normal_location_scale: median/IQR/normal-score quantiles by trace/app/documented context; heldout-normal FPR and event-duration-matched normal alarm rates required
F3.interpretation: baseline shift plus preserved separation required for dominance; no latent representation claim from aggregate F1

F4.unit: event descriptions nested within trace/app/shared cluster execution; no iid event or windows-as-N inference
F4.small_cells: 1-2 events are not independent scientific strata
F4.unknown: retain own stratum; no reinterpretation as known injected fault
F4.no_application_impact: retain descriptor, separate from application-impact CPU events; do not silently recode normal/unknown
F4.context: joint app/corrected-input-rate/batch/executors/memory support and shared-batch dependence; uncertain metadata stays unknown

training_policy.split_if_rerun: undisturbed traces only for fit/validation/calibration; chronological70/15/15 within each verified native trace with window-size guard; hold out whole normal traces for cross-trace FPR; exact membership and hashes require separate execution seal
execution_prerequisites: complete raw-feature quality and exact train/validation/normal-holdout membership per selected app/context
native dependency/checkpoint lineage, fixed architecture/window/epochs and common training budget
preserved original timestamps and point-RCI/overlap/missing-value/causal-score readout contract
counterfactual native-versus-causal preprocessing/readout audit before interpreting early detection
training_policy.reason_not_execute: Released sources do not supply an admissible score bundle or an execution manifest. This audit exposes source contracts that change apparent lifecycle attribution; fitting arbitrary small replacements would not resolve those contracts. No native runtime/configuration parity is asserted; the audit-only freeze is explicitly not a training execution seal.

positive_gate_requirements: replicatedtypes/apps, distinct baseline families, raw score separation + normal-only thresholds, no crash/truncation/sampling or single-context explanation, residual beyond explicit priorart; no positive gate from missing data

execution_runtime_probe.divad_dependencies: README Python3.9.19; tensorflow2.14.0,torch1.13.1,numpy1.26.4; DeepOD unpinned Git
execution_runtime_probe.status: no native runtime prepared or run; not an impossibility proof

post_freeze_contract_clarification.reason: Independent review fixes to enforce existing native-grid completeness and unambiguous delay definitions; no detector results read or computed
post_freeze_contract_clarification.timestamp_grid: epoch-zero cadence1s; off-grid score timestamps rejected
post_freeze_contract_clarification.overlap_counts: expected native-grid exclusions include unobserved shared instants; observed exclusions separate
